loginTitle: Control access. Keep the boundary clear.
loginDescription: Sign in to inspect and publish the configuration owned by this Controller.
desiredBoundary: Desired state only. Saving configuration does not confirm node application.
keyHelp: Use your independent management access key. It is exchanged for a server-side session, not saved in browser storage.
sessionBoundary: Single Controller sessions expire after 8 hours or 30 minutes of inactivity. Restart and credential rotation require a new sign-in.
editorHelp: Edit the complete policy and facts document. Shared validation runs before acceptance.
readOnly: Read-only access. Your current role cannot publish changes.
reasonHelp: Explain this change for the append-only publication audit.
noConfiguration: Configuration could not be read. Refresh to retry.
auditHelp: Configuration changes recorded in the same transaction as acceptance. This is not an enforcement or request-decision log.
discard: Discard your unsaved draft and load the latest configuration?
expired: Your session expired or access was revoked. Sign in again.
conflict: The revision changed. Your draft is preserved; reload explicitly before editing again.
saved: Desired configuration saved. Node application is not confirmed.
staleFailed: Last read failed. Displayed data may be stale.
staleAge: This view is over a minute old. Refresh before relying on it.
requestFailed: The request failed. Check connectivity and Controller readiness, then retry.

grants.title: Grants
grants.boundary: Each Grant has its own identity and deadline. Grants combine; an explicit deny still wins. Issuance is not confirmation of effective or applied access.
grants.rebaseConfirm: Keep your inputs and use the latest revision for this Grant operation? Review the pinned Resource and scope before submitting again.
grants.name: Grant name
grants.sourceHelp: Enter the actual network source explicitly. A CIDR shares access with every address in that network; this is not a verified person identity.
grants.noResources: No Resources exist. Publish Resource and binding configuration first in Desired configuration.
grants.expiryHelp: The server fixes an absolute expiry once. Reading, retrying or restarting cannot extend it.
grants.selectEndpoints: Select at least one named Endpoint
grants.fixFields: Check the following fields, then submit again.
grants.issued: Grant issued as desired state. Node application is not confirmed.
grants.discardAll: Sign out and discard your unsaved configuration and Grant drafts?
grants.conflictHelp: Writing is blocked until you explicitly use the latest Grant revision. Inputs are retained; a failed response may still have committed. Inspect the latest Grants before retrying.
grants.observed: Validity is evaluated at the last successful read, not live enforcement. Refresh to inspect changes. The YAML editor keeps its separate revision base.
grants.empty: No Grants on this page. Select a Resource and named Endpoints to issue access.
grants.future: Not yet valid at last read
grants.revokeHelp: Only this Grant is revoked. Other matching Grants may continue to allow access; explicit denies are unchanged.
grants.revoked: Grant revoked in desired state. Other Grants and node application must be inspected independently.
grants.finishDraft: Clear or finish the issue draft before revoking. Switching console tabs preserves this draft.

errors.unauthorized: Access key not accepted. Check the key or contact your administrator.
errors.forbidden: Your current role does not allow this operation.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait briefly before retrying.
errors.invalid_login: Enter a valid management access key.
errors.csrf_rejected: The request could not be verified. Refresh the page and sign in again.
errors.invalid_publication: The desired change did not pass validation. Check the source IP/CIDR, unique Grant name, pinned Resource and named Endpoints, or both configuration documents. Inputs are preserved.
errors.invalid_fields: Check the required fields and allowed duration. Inputs are preserved.
errors.grant_not_found: This Grant no longer exists. Refresh and inspect the current publication.
errors.management_unavailable: Management is unavailable. Check Controller readiness and credential configuration. A failed write response may still have committed; inspect the latest revision before retrying.
errors.session_unavailable: Sessions are unavailable. Check Controller readiness.
errors.request_too_large: The request exceeds the allowed size. Reduce the documents and retry.
errors.body_too_large: The request exceeds the allowed size. Reduce the selected Endpoints or input text.
errors.revision_required: There is no revision base. Explicitly load the latest configuration.
